package windows

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/hex"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/smb/internal/wire"
)

const cacheGatePositiveMaxFrame = 1 << 20
const cacheGatePositiveMaxPending = 256
const cacheGatePositiveMaxRecords = 8192

// Records contain protocol identity and selected fixed fields; authentication
// tokens and file bytes never enter the diagnostic output.
type cacheGatePositiveWireRecord struct {
	At            time.Time `json:"at"`
	Connection    uint64    `json:"connection"`
	Response      bool      `json:"response"`
	MessageID     uint64    `json:"message_id"`
	Command       uint16    `json:"command"`
	Status        uint32    `json:"status"`
	Flags         uint32    `json:"flags"`
	SessionID     uint64    `json:"session_id"`
	QueryType     byte      `json:"query_type,omitempty"`
	QueryClass    byte      `json:"query_class,omitempty"`
	FileID        string    `json:"file_id,omitempty"`
	Name          string    `json:"name,omitempty"`
	Offset        uint64    `json:"offset,omitempty"`
	Requested     uint32    `json:"requested,omitempty"`
	Count         uint32    `json:"count,omitempty"`
	Digest        string    `json:"digest,omitempty"`
	EOF           uint64    `json:"eof,omitempty"`
	MTime         uint64    `json:"mtime,omitempty"`
	InternalID    uint64    `json:"internal_id,omitempty"`
	Oplock        byte      `json:"oplock"`
	LeasePresent  bool      `json:"lease_present"`
	LeaseState    uint32    `json:"lease_state"`
	Incomplete    string    `json:"incomplete,omitempty"`
	Bootstrap     bool      `json:"bootstrap,omitempty"`
	RelatedCreate uint64    `json:"related_create,omitempty"`
	related       bool
}

type cacheGatePositiveStream struct {
	prefix [4]byte
	used   int
	frame  []byte
	length int
	failed bool
}
type cacheGatePositiveFrameObserver struct {
	mu         sync.Mutex
	id         uint64
	streams    [2]cacheGatePositiveStream
	pending    map[uint64]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord
	records    []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord
	incomplete bool
	bootstrap  bool
	emit       func(cacheGatePositiveWireRecord)
}

var cacheGatePositiveRegistry struct {
	sync.Mutex
	observers []*cacheGatePositiveFrameObserver
	overflow  bool
}

func cacheGateNewPositiveFrameObserver() *cacheGatePositiveFrameObserver {
	cacheGatePositiveRegistry.Lock()
	defer cacheGatePositiveRegistry.Unlock()
	o := &cacheGatePositiveFrameObserver{pending: make(map[uint64]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord)}
	if len(cacheGatePositiveRegistry.observers) >= 16 {
		cacheGatePositiveRegistry.overflow = true
		o.incomplete = true
		return o
	}
	o.id = uint64(len(cacheGatePositiveRegistry.observers) + 1)
	cacheGatePositiveRegistry.observers = append(cacheGatePositiveRegistry.observers, o)
	return o
}

func cacheGatePositiveWireSnapshot() ([]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, bool) {
	cacheGatePositiveRegistry.Lock()
	observers := append([]*cacheGatePositiveFrameObserver(nil), cacheGatePositiveRegistry.observers...)
	incomplete := cacheGatePositiveRegistry.overflow
	cacheGatePositiveRegistry.Unlock()
	var records []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord
	for _, o := range observers {
		o.mu.Lock()
		records = append(records, o.records...)
		incomplete = incomplete || o.incomplete
		o.mu.Unlock()
	}
	return records, incomplete
}

func (o *cacheGatePositiveFrameObserver) record(r cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) {
	r.At = time.Now()
	r.Connection = o.id
	if len(o.records) >= cacheGatePositiveMaxRecords {
		o.incomplete = true
		return
	}
	o.records = append(o.records, r)
	if o.emit != nil {
		o.emit(r)
	} else {
		cacheGateObserve("positive_wire", r)
	}
}
func (o *cacheGatePositiveFrameObserver) fail(response bool, reason string) {
	o.incomplete = true
	o.record(cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{Response: response, Incomplete: reason})
}
func (o *cacheGatePositiveFrameObserver) finish() {
	o.mu.Lock()
	defer o.mu.Unlock()
	for i := range o.streams {
		s := &o.streams[i]
		if s.used != 0 || len(s.frame) != 0 {
			o.fail(i == 1, "truncated TCP frame")
		}
		clear(s.frame)
		s.frame = nil
		s.used = 0
	}
}
func (o *cacheGatePositiveFrameObserver) observe(data []byte, response bool) {
	o.mu.Lock()
	defer o.mu.Unlock()
	index := 0
	if response {
		index = 1
	}
	s := &o.streams[index]
	if s.failed {
		return
	}
	for len(data) > 0 {
		if s.used < 4 {
			n := copy(s.prefix[s.used:], data)
			s.used += n
			data = data[n:]
			if s.used < 4 {
				return
			}
			s.length = int(s.prefix[1])<<16 | int(s.prefix[2])<<8 | int(s.prefix[3])
			if s.prefix[0] != 0 || s.length < 4 || s.length > cacheGatePositiveMaxFrame {
				o.fail(response, "invalid TCP frame length or type")
				s.failed = true
				return
			}
			s.frame = make([]byte, 0, s.length)
		}
		n := min(len(data), s.length-len(s.frame))
		s.frame = append(s.frame, data[:n]...)
		data = data[n:]
		if len(s.frame) == s.length {
			o.frame(s.frame, response)
			clear(s.frame)
			s.frame = nil
			s.used = 0
		}
	}
}

func cacheGatePositiveField(packet []byte, offset, length uint32, minimum int) ([]byte, bool) {
	if length == 0 {
		return nil, offset == 0 || uint64(offset) >= uint64(minimum) && uint64(offset) <= uint64(len(packet))
	}
	end := uint64(offset) + uint64(length)
	if uint64(offset) < uint64(minimum) || end > uint64(len(packet)) {
		return nil, false
	}
	return packet[int(offset):int(end)], true
}
func cacheGatePositiveFixed(body []byte, size uint16, minimum int) bool {
	return len(body) >= minimum && binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(body[:2]) == size
}
func cacheGatePositiveRelatedID(id string) bool { return id == "ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff" }

func (o *cacheGatePositiveFrameObserver) frame(packet []byte, response bool) {
	if string(packet[:4]) == "\xffSMB" && !response {
		if wire.ParseMultiProtocolNegotiate(packet) != nil {
			o.fail(response, "invalid SMB1 negotiate bootstrap")
			return
		}
		o.bootstrap = true
		o.record(cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{Bootstrap: true, Command: wire.Negotiate})
		return
	}
	var createMID uint64
	hasCreate := false
	for commands := 0; ; commands++ {
		if commands >= 64 {
			o.fail(response, "compound command bound exceeded")
			return
		}
		h, err := wire.ParseHeader(packet)
		if err != nil || (h.Flags&wire.FlagResponse != 0) != response {
			o.fail(response, "malformed or transformed SMB header")
			return
		}
		end := len(packet)
		if h.NextCommand != 0 {
			if h.NextCommand < wire.HeaderSize+8 || h.NextCommand&7 != 0 || uint64(h.NextCommand)+wire.HeaderSize > uint64(len(packet)) {
				o.fail(response, "invalid NextCommand")
				return
			}
			end = int(h.NextCommand)
		}
		member := packet[:end]
		body := member[wire.HeaderSize:]
		r := cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{Response: response, MessageID: h.MessageID, Command: h.Command, Status: h.Status, Flags: h.Flags, SessionID: h.SessionID}
		valid := true
		if response {
			req, ok := o.pending[h.MessageID]
			if !ok && h.Command == wire.Negotiate && o.bootstrap {
				o.bootstrap = false
				ok = true
				req.Command = wire.Negotiate
			}
			// Unsolicited lease/oplock notifications have no request MessageID.
			if !ok && h.Command == wire.OplockBreak && h.MessageID == ^uint64(0) {
				ok = true
				req.Command = h.Command
			}
			if !ok || req.Command != h.Command {
				o.fail(response, "response has no matching request")
				valid = false
			} else {
				r.QueryType, r.QueryClass, r.FileID, r.Name = req.QueryType, req.QueryClass, req.FileID, req.Name
				r.Offset, r.Requested = req.Offset, req.Requested
				r.RelatedCreate, r.related = req.RelatedCreate, req.related
			}
			if h.Status != 0x00000103 {
				delete(o.pending, h.MessageID)
			}
			if h.Status == 0 {
				valid = o.response(member, &r) && valid
			} else {
				// Error payloads may contain opaque contexts; record only the NTSTATUS.
				if !cacheGatePositiveFixed(body, 9, 8) {
					valid = false
				}
				selectedQuery := r.Command == wire.QueryInfo && r.QueryType == 1 &&
					(r.QueryClass == 4 || r.QueryClass == 5 || r.QueryClass == 6 || r.QueryClass == 18 || r.QueryClass == 34)
				if (selectedQuery || r.Command == wire.Read) && (h.Status == 0x80000005 || h.Status == 0xc0000023) {
					valid = false
				}
			}
			if valid && h.Command == wire.Create && h.Status == 0 {
				for mid, p := range o.pending {
					if p.related && p.RelatedCreate == h.MessageID {
						p.FileID = r.FileID
						p.Name = r.Name
						p.related = false
						o.pending[mid] = p
					}
				}
			}
		} else {
			valid = o.request(member, &r)
			if h.Command == wire.Create {
				createMID = h.MessageID
				hasCreate = true
			}
			if cacheGatePositiveRelatedID(r.FileID) {
				if h.Flags&wire.FlagRelated == 0 || !hasCreate {
					valid = false
				} else {
					r.RelatedCreate = createMID
					r.related = true
				}
			}
			if h.Command != wire.Cancel {
				if _, exists := o.pending[h.MessageID]; exists {
					valid = false
					o.fail(response, "duplicate pending MessageID")
				}
				if len(o.pending) >= cacheGatePositiveMaxPending {
					valid = false
					o.fail(response, "request correlation bound exceeded")
				} else {
					o.pending[h.MessageID] = r
				}
			}
		}
		if !valid {
			r.Incomplete = "invalid selected command or correlation"
			o.incomplete = true
		}
		o.record(r)
		if h.NextCommand == 0 {
			return
		}
		packet = packet[end:]
	}
}

func (o *cacheGatePositiveFrameObserver) request(packet []byte, r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) bool {
	body := packet[wire.HeaderSize:]
	if len(body) < 2 {
		return false
	}
	le := binary.LittleEndian
	switch r.Command {
	case wire.QueryInfo:
		if !cacheGatePositiveFixed(body, 41, 40) {
			return false
		}
		r.QueryType, r.QueryClass = body[2], body[3]
		r.FileID = hex.EncodeToString(body[24:40])
		_, ok := cacheGatePositiveField(packet, uint32(le.Uint16(body[8:10])), le.Uint32(body[12:16]), 104)
		return ok
	case wire.Read:
		if !cacheGatePositiveFixed(body, 49, 48) {
			return false
		}
		r.Requested = le.Uint32(body[4:8])
		r.Offset = le.Uint64(body[8:16])
		r.FileID = hex.EncodeToString(body[16:32])
		_, ok := cacheGatePositiveField(packet, uint32(le.Uint16(body[44:46])), uint32(le.Uint16(body[46:48])), 112)
		return ok
	case wire.Create:
		if !cacheGatePositiveFixed(body, 57, 56) {
			return false
		}
		r.Oplock = body[3]
		name, ok := cacheGatePositiveField(packet, uint32(le.Uint16(body[44:46])), uint32(le.Uint16(body[46:48])), 120)
		if !ok || len(name) > 4096 {
			return false
		}
		var err error
		r.Name, err = wire.DecodeUTF16(name)
		if err != nil {
			return false
		}
		return cacheGatePositiveContexts(packet, le.Uint32(body[48:52]), le.Uint32(body[52:56]), 120, r)
	case wire.Close, wire.Flush:
		if !cacheGatePositiveFixed(body, 24, 24) {
			return false
		}
		r.FileID = hex.EncodeToString(body[8:24])
	}
	return true
}

func (o *cacheGatePositiveFrameObserver) response(packet []byte, r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) bool {
	body := packet[wire.HeaderSize:]
	if len(body) < 2 {
		return false
	}
	le := binary.LittleEndian
	switch r.Command {
	case wire.Create:
		if !cacheGatePositiveFixed(body, 89, 88) {
			return false
		}
		r.Oplock = body[2]
		r.MTime = le.Uint64(body[24:32])
		r.EOF = le.Uint64(body[48:56])
		r.FileID = hex.EncodeToString(body[64:80])
		return cacheGatePositiveContexts(packet, le.Uint32(body[80:84]), le.Uint32(body[84:88]), 152, r)
	case wire.QueryInfo:
		if !cacheGatePositiveFixed(body, 9, 8) {
			return false
		}
		data, ok := cacheGatePositiveField(packet, uint32(le.Uint16(body[2:4])), le.Uint32(body[4:8]), 72)
		if !ok {
			return false
		}
		if r.QueryType != 1 {
			return true
		}
		switch r.QueryClass {
		case 4: // FILE_BASIC_INFORMATION
			if len(data) != 40 {
				return false
			}
			r.MTime = le.Uint64(data[16:24])
		case 5: // FILE_STANDARD_INFORMATION
			if len(data) != 24 {
				return false
			}
			r.EOF = le.Uint64(data[8:16])
		case 6: // FILE_INTERNAL_INFORMATION
			if len(data) != 8 {
				return false
			}
			r.InternalID = le.Uint64(data)
		case 18: // FILE_ALL_INFORMATION, with bounded trailing name.
			if len(data) < 100 || uint64(le.Uint32(data[96:100])) > uint64(len(data)-100) {
				return false
			}
			r.MTime = le.Uint64(data[16:24])
			r.EOF = le.Uint64(data[48:56])
			r.InternalID = le.Uint64(data[64:72])
		case 34: // FILE_NETWORK_OPEN_INFORMATION
			if len(data) != 56 {
				return false
			}
			r.MTime = le.Uint64(data[16:24])
			r.EOF = le.Uint64(data[40:48])
		}
	case wire.Read:
		if !cacheGatePositiveFixed(body, 17, 16) {
			return false
		}
		r.Count = le.Uint32(body[4:8])
		if r.Count > r.Requested {
			return false
		}
		data, ok := cacheGatePositiveField(packet, uint32(body[2]), r.Count, 80)
		if !ok {
			return false
		}
		digest := sha256.Sum256(data)
		r.Digest = hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
	}
	return true
}

func cacheGatePositiveContexts(packet []byte, offset, length uint32, minimum int, r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) bool {
	data, ok := cacheGatePositiveField(packet, offset, length, minimum)
	if !ok || len(data) > 0 && offset&7 != 0 {
		return false
	}
	le := binary.LittleEndian
	for count := 0; len(data) > 0; count++ {
		if count >= 32 || len(data) < 16 {
			return false
		}
		next := le.Uint32(data[:4])
		end := len(data)
		if next != 0 {
			if next < 16 || next&7 != 0 || uint64(next)+16 > uint64(len(data)) {
				return false
			}
			end = int(next)
		}
		name, ok := cacheGatePositiveField(data[:end], uint32(le.Uint16(data[4:6])), uint32(le.Uint16(data[6:8])), 16)
		if !ok || len(name) == 0 {
			return false
		}
		value, ok := cacheGatePositiveField(data[:end], uint32(le.Uint16(data[10:12])), le.Uint32(data[12:16]), 16)
		if !ok {
			return false
		}
		if string(name) == "RqLs" {
			if r.LeasePresent || len(value) != 32 && len(value) != 52 {
				return false
			}
			r.LeasePresent = true
			r.LeaseState = le.Uint32(value[16:20])
			if r.LeaseState & ^uint32(7) != 0 {
				return false
			}
		}
		if next == 0 {
			return true
		}
		data = data[end:]
	}
	return true
}

// Reset is called only after the previous bridge has closed every connection.
func cacheGateResetPositiveWire() {
	cacheGatePositiveRegistry.Lock()
	defer cacheGatePositiveRegistry.Unlock()
	clear(cacheGatePositiveRegistry.observers)
	cacheGatePositiveRegistry.observers = nil
	cacheGatePositiveRegistry.overflow = false
}
